method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse paraphrase of both identity axiom schemas and their two derivability consequences, direct replay of the two modus-ponens applications, and exact formula, macro, token, label and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Identity in axiomatic deduction: the reflexivity and substitutivity axiom schemas, their validity exercise, and the resulting derivability principles.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The unit belongs to axiomatic deduction and extends the unchanged definition of derivation by allowing new identity axiom schemas.
samples.checks: The heading retains both controlled token macros. OLAXD-009 changes only the stale chapter comment from axiomatic-proofs to the path- and file-ID-consistent axiomatic-deduction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For closed terms, identity is reflexive and an identity t1=t2 licenses the conditional from B(t1) to B(t2). Both schemas are valid; their validity proof is assigned as an exercise and repeated as a problem.
samples.checks: Both axiom labels, all term indices, the nested conditional, closed-term restriction, validity claim and indexed problem reference are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Every term derives its self-identity relative to any Gamma. If Gamma derives A(t1) and t1=t2, it derives A(t2): the displayed instance of id2 combines with those two premises by two applications of modus ponens.
samples.checks: The two proposition directions, all three derivability formulas, displayed axiom instance, id2 reference and exact count of modus-ponens applications are preserved.

source_observations: OLAXD-009 records that the frozen header says axiomatic-proofs although the manifest path, directory and fol/axd/ide identifier all place the unit in axiomatic-deduction.

The formal definition restricts the two new axiom schemas to closed terms, while the first following proposition repeats the frozen phrase any term; the translation preserves that wording without silently narrowing the proposition.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly; the only source correction is a non-rendered comment.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The specialist identity and axiomatic-derivation vocabulary remains governed by provisional decisions T031, T167 and T184.
The frozen source leaves validity of the identity schemas as an exercise; the translation does not supply that proof.
